# NoCapsAI LLC

> NoCapsAI is based in Rushville, Indiana and provides funding tools, grant management software, and website services for nonprofits and small businesses.

## Products and services

- [Funding tools and templates](https://nocapsai.com/shop/): Downloadable guides, grant trackers, and toolkits.
- [GrantFlow Pro](https://nocapsai.com/grantflow/): Grant discovery, application drafting, and deadline tracking.
- [Website design and grant support](https://nocapsai.com/services/): Nonprofit websites, donation pages, QR campaigns, and grant support.
- [Pricing](https://nocapsai.com/pricing/): Business websites $2,500 / $5,500 / $10,500, nonprofit websites from $750, a $0-down $59/month website ownership plan, AI receptionist, automation and custom software MVPs up to $22,500.
- [Monthly nonprofit outreach](https://nocapsai.com/marketing/): Social content, campaign materials, and event promotion.

## Project examples

- [Twizted Journeys](https://nocapsai.com/case-studies/twizted-journeys/): Nonprofit website and campaign support.
- [We Help Dads](https://nocapsai.com/case-studies/we-help-dads/): Website for the nonprofit and its Dedicated Dads program.

## Contact

- [Contact NoCapsAI](https://nocapsai.com/contact/): Business inquiries and project quotes.
